name: Cubus Mortis
source:
You live a boring day to day life, full of bothersome work. One day, you find a tiny cube that claims to fulfill your wish, at the cost of someone's life.

That wish could be anything, it's all up to you, and as well as up to you to deal with the consequences.

What choice will you make?
